items.title: Epoch AI data centers (global) — 2026-11-02
items.summary: Epoch AI covers 96 large AI data centers (76 drawing power now): 15.1 GW current power, 15.8M H100-equivalents, 10 countries with capacity. By power: United States 12.58 GW (83%), Malaysia 1.25 GW (8%), China 0.89 GW (6%), United Kingdom 0.09 GW (1%). Indiana: 3 sites, 1.22 GW = 8.1% of the covered global total (Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle (1037 MW), Meta Jeffersonville (178 MW), Google Fort Wayne (0 MW)). Covered set only, not world capacity; skewed to the US. Dataset updated 2026-11-01.
